experiment: Experiment 75.4 — DPUSA: Disease Prompt Utility and Semantic Specificity Audit

data.fold_protocol: Reuse E74.4-G2 test indices and best checkpoints unchanged; new probes train only on outer-training nodes excluding any train/test overlap.

text_encoder.name: OpenAI CLIP RN50
text_encoder.preprocess: Use E60 audited tokenizer/encoder implementation; cache existing P1/P2 vectors; encode only new candidate and unrelated sentences once.

analysis.inner_cv_split_policy: For each outer fold, every S0/S1/S2/S3, M0/M1/M2, B1/B2, and prompt/control probe reuses StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=shared_inner_split_seed_base+fold).
analysis.selection_metric: mean inner-validation log-loss; ties choose smaller C
analysis.B2_optimizer: Adam, lr=0.03, 40 full-batch steps, deterministic CPU, same initialization per fold and prompt bank
analysis.sign_flip: exact two-sided paired fold sign-flip enumeration (2^10 for ten folds); exploratory because CV folds share training data

protocol_limitations: Historical Fold 2 has train/test label overlap for 1-based rows 377 (ASD) and 407 (TD). These rows are removed from all new probe training and hyperparameter selection.
E74.4 checkpoint selection used val=test; source preprocessing occurred before outer CV; the 871-node graph is transductive.
Results are paired exploratory diagnostics on frozen historical models, not an unbiased independent-generalization estimate.
